meta.title: Visual Abstraction & Refinement
meta.subTitle: Visual Abstraction & Refinement
meta.desc: Close the loop between Bottom-Up Extraction and Top-Down Concretization. Master gesture axes, convex hulls, Notan structures, and dominant color clustering.

settings.showToleranceBandDesc: Display dynamic tolerance interval around the hover cursor

abs_gesture_axis.title: Gesture Axis Extraction
abs_gesture_axis.desc: Extract the primary PCA gesture axis angle from flowing particle fields.
abs_gesture_axis.instruction: Rotate the primary axis to align with the main particle flow (0°~180°).
abs_gesture_axis.hint: Rotate the primary axis to align with the particle flow (0°~180°)
abs_gesture_axis.label: Gesture Axis Angle:

abs_polygon_decimation.title: Polygon Hull Decimation
abs_polygon_decimation.desc: Filter high-frequency noise from intricate silhouettes to identify the optimal low-poly hull.
abs_polygon_decimation.instruction: Select the simplified polygon that best preserves key structural vertices.
abs_polygon_decimation.hint: Select the simplified polygon that best preserves key structural vertices

abs_notan_threshold.title: Notan Value Thresholding
abs_notan_threshold.desc: Modulate the binarization cutoff threshold to extract solid Notan value groupings.
abs_notan_threshold.instruction: Adjust the threshold slider to find the most balanced Notan state.
abs_notan_threshold.hint: Observe the raw scene on the left, then adjust the Notan threshold slider below
abs_notan_threshold.label: Binarization Threshold:

abs_palette_clustering.title: Dominant Color Clustering
abs_palette_clustering.desc: Pierce mosaic noise to identify the area-weighted dominant centroid color (4AFC).
abs_palette_clustering.instruction: Select the dominant color that represents the overall scene palette.
abs_palette_clustering.hint: Select the dominant color representing the overall palette (Keys 1-4)

abs_td_gesture_2afc.title: Top-Down Gesture Match
abs_td_gesture_2afc.desc: Given an abstract spine, identify which complex particle field follows that dynamic.
abs_td_gesture_2afc.instruction: Identify which particle field conforms to the prompt spine (Keys 1 / 2).
abs_td_gesture_2afc.hint: Identify which detailed field conforms to the prompt spine above

abs_td_hull_2afc.title: Top-Down Hull Match
abs_td_hull_2afc.desc: Given a minimalist convex hull, match its detailed organic silhouette.
abs_td_hull_2afc.instruction: Identify which detailed silhouette conforms to the prompt hull (Keys 1 / 2).
abs_td_hull_2afc.hint: Identify which detailed silhouette conforms to the prompt hull above

abs_td_notan_2afc.title: Top-Down Notan Match
abs_td_notan_2afc.desc: Given a binary Notan silhouette, match the grayscale scene with that value foundation.
abs_td_notan_2afc.instruction: Identify which grayscale scene shares this Notan foundation (Keys 1 / 2).
abs_td_notan_2afc.hint: Identify which grayscale scene shares the Notan foundation above

abs_td_palette_2afc.title: Top-Down Palette Match
abs_td_palette_2afc.desc: Given a prompt dominant color, match the mosaic pattern sharing that tonality.
abs_td_palette_2afc.instruction: Select the mosaic pattern with the matching dominant color base (Keys 1-4).
abs_td_palette_2afc.hint: Observe the dominant color above and select the matching mosaic pattern (Keys 1-4)
